name: Scientist
description: Science is an almost exclusively female occupation among the Aslan. The exception is that of doctor — by ancient tradition, males are allowed to practise the art of the physician, dating back to when males fought on the battlefield.

healer.name: Healer
healer.description: You tend the sick and wounded.

researcher.name: Researcher
researcher.description: You develop new inventions and technologies for your clan.

explorer.name: Explorer
explorer.description: You explore new worlds and catalogue useful resources.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: A lab accident exposes you to something dangerous. Lose END −1.
mishaps.3: Another researcher sabotages your work. Gain a Rival. You may continue in this career if you wish but gain no Benefit rolls from this term.
mishaps.4: A lab ship misjumps, stranding you on an alien world. Gain one of Survival 1, Astrogation 1, Mechanic 1 or Science 1.
mishaps.5: A clan elder challenges your work as being flawed. You may challenge the elder if you wish. If you challenge, roll Melee (Natural) 8+. If you succeed, increase your SOC +1 and you may continue with this career. If you fail, reduce your SOC −2 and leave this career.
mishaps.6: Your clan cancels your line of research. You may, if you wish, leave to continue it in human space — you may automatically qualify for the Scholar career from the Traveller Core Rulebook next term.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishap table but you are not ejected from this career.
events.3: Spending all your time in the laboratory is never a good thing. Gain one of Carouse 1, Survival 1, Streetwise 1 or a Contact.
events.4: You are assigned to work on weapons technology for your clan. Gain one of Science 1, Engineer 1, Gunner 1 or Gun Combat 1.
events.5: You work closely with a scientist from another species. Gain Tolerance 1 and a Contact.
events.6: You are given advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain any skill.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Aslan Life Events table.
events.8: You teach the young cubs of your clan. Gain Admin 1, Art 1, Science 1 or a Contact.
events.9: A researcher working for another clan is close to making a breakthrough you covet. You can try to complete your research first (roll Science 10+; fail = lose Benefit rolls, succeed = DM+2 next advancement), attempt to sabotage their work (roll Stealth or Deception 8+; fail = SOC −2, succeed = DM+2 next advancement), or do nothing. Either way, gain the researcher as a Rival or Enemy depending on the path.
events.10: You obtain a rare alien artefact or life form to study. Roll any Science 8+. If you succeed, you uncover the subject's secrets and gain DM+2 to your next advancement roll. If you fail, suffer DM-2 to your next advancement roll.
events.11: You study at one of the great universities or research facilities. Gain Investigate 1, or gain DM+4 to your next advancement roll.
events.12: You make a scientific breakthrough. You are automatically promoted.

mustering_dm_notes: DM+1 if SOC 9+. DM+1 when rolling on Benefits if Male.
